subject: ggplot2 feature request: excel-like nested axes

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: ggplot2 feature request: excel-like nested axes
parts:
Hi,

Excel (hated excel) allows nested axes, for instance year and
month. These are demarcated by labels with range bounds in the axis.
e.g each year gets a year label and long axis ticks, with querters or
or months nested within.

I'd like to see ggplot2 incorporate this idea - which could be
achieved by multiple ordered scales.

-Alex

No, it's not the same. excel can plot two stacked axes - one with
year labels and one with month labels, or surname/firstname, or
whatever.

It's about the only feature of excel graphs I want that I don't have.

please take a look at the image labelled: Chart Axis Labels Option 2 –

first in google.
